dimensions.note: 자본시장연구원's '2026년 거시경제 주요 이슈' 자본시장포커스 article independently corroborates the graded-hedging trait already found at KDI (ref:kdi-economic-outlook-report, discovery), at a third institution and in a different subgenre (capital-markets commentary rather than a national macro forecast or an industry outlook). It reaches for the same family of evidential/probabilistic closing predicates rather than flat assertion: '것으로 전망된다' (projected/forecast to), '모습이다' (appears to be), and a stacked conditional-plus-modal caution ('~할 수 있다는 점에 유의해야 할 것이다'). This record validates the hedging trait; it does not originate it.
dimensions.evidence: "2026년 국내 경제는 2.0%의 성장률로 완만한 회복세를 이어갈 것으로 전망된다." / "...경제주체들의 불안도 커진 모습이다." / "...RP시장의 위험이 증가할 수 있다는 점에 유의해야 할 것이다."

dimensions.note: The stacked double-hedge on the risk-warning sentence ('~할 수 있다는 점에 유의해야 할 것이다' — modal possibility + a nominalized 'point to note' + a further modal obligation, three hedging layers in one clause) reads as house-specific caution-formula phrasing rather than a general report-genre convention; it was not observed at KDI or KIET in this pass. Flagging it as a publisher-local quirk, not something to reproduce as if it were how Korean institutional hedging generally works.
dimensions.evidence: "금리 급등 및 변동성 확대 시 전술한 경로를 통해 RP시장의 위험이 증가할 수 있다는 점에 유의해야 할 것이다." — three stacked hedges plus a translationese-adjacent nominal phrase ('전술한 경로를 통해').

strengths: Independent-institution corroboration (a third institution, capital-markets subgenre) of graded causal/probabilistic hedging in report register: forecasts and risk claims close on evidential predicates ('것으로 전망된다', '모습이다') rather than flat declaratives, consistent with the same discipline found at KDI.
weaknesses: The triple-stacked hedge-plus-caution formula on the RP-market risk sentence is this outlet's own house phrasing, not a corroborated cross-institution report convention — do_not_copy, not adopt, and it should not be generalized past this one document.
Only one 자본시장포커스 issue was read; broader claims about KCMI's register across its full publication series are not supported by this record.
